patch_description: The current 5-distinct-parameter candidate (0.69) underperforms the earlier 2-distinct-parameter seed (0.74) — parameter economy dominates scoring, so we revert to the leaner "ry_a"+"theta" shared-parameter structure from the best prior seed (the shorter-depth variant, depth 99/gate_count 198), and apply the suggested improvement: insert a mid-block global RZ("theta") layer between the XX ring and the backward CNOT ladder. This deepens the sandwich structure (RZ-entangle-RZ-entangle-RZ) without adding any new trainable parameter name, which the evidence suggests boosts validation_margin further while keeping n_distinct_params at 2 for maximum parameter efficiency.
